items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: they come to town, they work downtown at the hotels, so when they get off from work, they come out South where we worked at, so's that's how come we get a chance to meet all those people

ctx.x: Count Basie an' them's band was downtown at a nightclub, an' we was on the other side of town...colored joint. So, when they got off from work, they come out there where we was workin' at, but we stayed open later'n they did. And we'd have a jam session. Ever'body sit in and have a jam session.

We had a cat called "The Fiddler." He played the violin. He was good. But some white boy come through there, played the violin, so we had a contest. White boy outplayed "The Fiddler." He really did. So, we used to have a lot of fun like that. Different cats come in from outa town, like, uh, Stepin Fetchit, Ina Ray Hutton...mmmmn, they come to town, they work downtown at the hotels, so when they get off from work, they come out South where we worked at, so's that's how come we get a chance to meet all those…
We had...Benny Goodman came in...used to get his whole band.
